title: Loureirin B Accelerates Diabetic Wound Healing by Promoting TGFbeta/Smad-Dependent Macrophage M2 Polarization: A Concerted Analytical Approach Through Single-Cell RNA Sequencing and Experimental Verification.
authors: Fan, Weijing; Qu, Yin; Yuan, Xin; Shi, Hongshuo; Liu, Guobin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物LB通过TGFbeta/Smad通路促进巨噬细胞M2极化加速糖尿病伤口愈合，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法核心，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Diabetic wound (DW) represent a significant clinical challenge and often fail to heal effectively. Loureirin B (LB), a flavonoid extracted from dragon's blood, has shown potential by influencing macrophage polarization and promoting wound healing. However, its mechanisms and efficacy in DW remain to be explored. This study employed single-cell RNA sequencing to analyze the classification of cells in diabetic foot ulcers and to identify the related mechanisms influenced by macrophages. Molecular docking was used to predict the interactions of LB with key proteins in the TGFbeta/Smad signaling pathway. The effects of LB on macrophage polarization and wound healing were further validated through in vitro and in vivo experiments using a DW model. Single-cell analysis identified specific macrophage subtypes involved in the DW healing process and highlighted the role of the TGFbeta/Smad pathway. Molecular docking suggested the potential action within the TGFbeta/Smad pathway. In vitro studies showed that under high glucose conditions, LB promoted macrophage polarization from pro-inflammatory M1 to healing-promoting M2 and ECM production in fibroblasts by activating TGF-beta/Smad signaling. In vivo, LB treatment enhanced wound healing rates in diabetic mice and promoted macrophage M2 polarization and fibroblast synthesis of ECM by activating TGF-beta/Smad signaling. LB regulates macrophage M2 polarization and fibroblast synthesis of ECM by activating TGF-beta/Smad signaling to promote DW healing. These findings suggest that LB could be a potential therapeutic agent for improving DW healing, emphasizing the need for further clinical studies to explore its efficacy and mechanisms in human subjects.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病创面（DW）是临床上的重大挑战，往往难以有效愈合。龙血竭中提取的黄酮类化合物龙血素B（LB）通过影响巨噬细胞极化和促进创面愈合显示出潜力，但其在糖尿病创面中的机制和疗效仍有待探索。本研究采用单细胞RNA测序分析糖尿病足溃疡中细胞的分类，并识别受巨噬细胞影响的相关机制。利用分子对接预测LB与TGFbeta/Smad信号通路中关键蛋白的相互作用。通过体外和体内实验，使用糖尿病创面模型进一步验证LB对巨噬细胞极化和创面愈合的影响。单细胞分析识别了参与糖尿病创面愈合过程的特定巨噬细胞亚型，并强调了TGFbeta/Smad通路的作用。分子对接提示其在TGFbeta/Smad通路中的潜在作用。体外研究表明，在高糖条件下，LB通过激活TGF-beta/Smad信号，促进巨噬细胞从促炎性M1型向促愈合M2型极化，并促进成纤维细胞产生细胞外基质（ECM）。体内实验中，LB处理提高了糖尿病小鼠的创面愈合率，并通过激活TGF-beta/Smad信号促进巨噬细胞M2极化和成纤维细胞合成ECM。LB通过激活TGF-beta/Smad信号调节巨噬细胞M2极化和成纤维细胞合成ECM，从而促进糖尿病创面愈合。这些发现表明，LB可能是改善糖尿病创面愈合的潜在治疗药物，强调需要进一步的临床研究来探索其在人类受试者中的疗效和机制。
